suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide an electronic method to create, amend, and delete ISINs for money market instruments.
The system shall automatically issue ISINs in response to an electronic SWIFT request.
The system shall use the MT 598 User Defined SWIFT message format for all communications.
The system shall use the ISIN prefix ZAM for money market instruments.
The system shall use the branch code ISN as an extension of the JSE's current BIC address.
The system shall support the nine defined SWIFT message types for ISIN request, rejection, and acceptance flows.
The system shall provide a front-end interface for inputting manual ISINs for BCP purposes.
The system shall provide a front-end interface to update issuer codes.
The system shall provide a screen to view and print rejections from JSE to STRATE and STRATE to JSE.
The system shall send an email notification to Clearing & Settlement at the time of a rejection.
The system shall provide a screen to view and print issued, de-issued, and matured ISINs.
The system shall provide parameter-driven screens to view and print active, cancelled, and de-registered ISINs based on issuer, category, or date.
The system shall be safe, secure, structured, formalised, and robust.
The system shall support the immediate issuance of ISINs to facilitate T+0 trading and settlement.
The system shall maintain records of cancelled and de-registered ISINs for at least 12 months.
